diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in identical decisions (reflashing 4800 modules, 0 scrap, 0 recalibration) based only on public facts S1-S3. While no checks passed, the model's tendency to default to 'oftware checksum validation' and 'eflash all' suggests that the specific values required by PF1 (4,488 releases, 312 re-flashes) are being bypassed by generic error-correction heuristics.
